subject.title: fix(docs): bound channel docs find fallback with timeout

question: Should this test helper accept the documented best-effort timeout, or should it be refactored to an isolated asynchronous worker so a stalled filesystem cannot block the parent test process?
rationale: The remaining defect is structural: retaining a synchronous API favors a small patch, while a real parent-process liveness guarantee requires changing the execution boundary and cleanup contract.

options.title: Isolate the filesystem probe
options.body: Replace the synchronous probe with an asynchronous isolated worker whose timeout returns control to the test runner even if the worker remains stuck.

options.title: Accept best-effort behavior
options.body: Merge the current change as a cooperative-child improvement while explicitly accepting that a D-state filesystem stall can still hang the suite.

recommendation.title: Isolate the filesystem probe
recommendation.body: Replace the synchronous probe with an asynchronous isolated worker whose timeout returns control to the test runner even if the worker remains stuck.
